name: The Street That Unpeels
prompt: Wind a tight spiral of citrus-coloured stall fronts around a communal chopping block. Vendors hinge the outermost fronts down into counters, unrolling the market into a longer street. An empty arc of sockets shows yesterday's tighter configuration.

name: The Suspended Weighhouse
prompt: Suspend a horizontal grid of woven baskets from a few tall timber frames. Sellers lower individual baskets to shoppers and raise payment in blue cups on counterweight cords. A diagonal of low baskets reveals the morning's busiest produce.

name: The Tablecloth Exchange
prompt: Stretch a broad blue checked cloth over a square courtyard, with one stall in each missing square. Traders pass goods through the openings and diners eat along the cloth's connected edges. A tailor mends a frayed corner during lunch.

name: A Market by the Slice
prompt: Set up narrow wedge-shaped stalls around a giant shared white cutting slab. Each wedge sells one ingredient. Shoppers walk around once to assemble a meal; the chef at the open wedge cooks the combined basket on a black griddle.

name: The Awning Library
prompt: Make a row of plain low counters beneath a rack of vivid rolled awnings. In the morning each vendor borrows an awning suited to the day's shade and display. One long saffron canopy bridges three stalls into a temporary feast.
